scope: Full-descriptor audit of Pathfinder c(List):ArrayList and a shared-fallback evaluation-order follow-up for b(List).

checks: Complete original and final compiled owner read using javap -c -p -s; exact b/c descriptors and all 135 original exception handlers reviewed.

Ordered field read/write plus non-identity invocation stream has no unmatched event: 61 events for b(List), 115 for c(List). Owners, descriptors, receivers, ordering and direct state side effects were checked.

Ordered floating/double/string constants match: 9 for b(List), 26 for c(List). Reviewed all normal branches, list operations, geometry/collision calls, early returns, movement scoring and output key ordering.

c(List) guard-null fallback does not read Minecraft.player; smoother receiver and sized output are evaluated before the iterator; it obtains/casts at most the first input node then exits before node position access/add. Non-null guard + null player maps all positions.
b(List) receiver load timing follow-up; both methods retain original Iterable.iterator and Collection.add invocation owners.

Final bytecode has 2 and 6 Intrinsics.checkNotNullExpressionValue checks in b/c respectively. Original exception handlers only catch NoWhenBranchMatchedException and route through verified identity a(Throwable):Throwable; Java rewrite swallows no exceptions.
